explanation: This method is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because .format(user_id, project_id) injects arguments directly into raw SQL strings executed via db.engine.execute(). If unvalidated values reach user_id or project_id, an attacker could manipulate the SELECT or UPDATE statement. The repair adopts SQLAlchemy text() with named bind parameters, which fixes the UPDATE query, but leaves :project_id inside single-quoted '{{:project_id}}' in the first query where bind parameters are not expanded.
